name: com.ortho-earth.unity
description: Bring ortho-earth exports (terrain, PLATEAU buildings, point clouds) into a Unity 6 scene, and send Unity models back to the ortho-earth globe. Anchor = lon/lat/ellipsoidal height; Unity X = east, Y = up, Z = north, 1 unit = 1 m.

samples.description: Anchor, attribution and a 4-point check PLY for a 2–3 block export around Tokyo Station. Run sdk/ortho-export (command in the sample's README) to produce terrain.glb and buildings.glb next to them, then Ortho Earth > Place export folder in scene…
